reason: $29.99 for 30 days of magnesium is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. The named lab and batch reports are a real plus, but I have never heard of this brand and I would want to read reviews first, and there are none yet.
objection: Price for a brand with no reviews yet. I can't check a 200 mg dose and a lab report against what real buyers say, so I'd rather stay with what I know.
would_change_my_mind: A batch lab report I can open and check, plus a few dozen honest verified reviews, at a price closer to $20 to $25 for the box.
